subject: Missing access form
text:
Hi,

Thanks so much for getting started with us! I was reviewing your account and noticed something small, but I wanted to ask before it becomes a bigger annoyance. Here is my quick question for our colleague: did the welcome email include the signed access form as an attachment? For some reason, it looks like the file was missing on our side. If you have it, simply reply with the PDF when you have a moment, and I will attach it to your ticket. If not, I can ask onboarding to resend it today. Either way, no need to worry. We are just trying to avoid hiccups while getting your dashboard ready. Please keep me posted and let me know if support can help further really, and if you spot the signed copy, forward it to this thread.

Cheers,
